results.reader_title: Hungarian manufacturing caught in FDI dependence
results.reader_what: The study finds some FDI-intensive Hungarian regions stopped catching up after 2015 amid weak innovation upgrading.
results.reader_why: Reliance on foreign-controlled assembly capacity can constrain European industrial resilience and autonomy.
results.reader_more: Researchers classify five NUTS-3 regional industrial trajectories. Industrial catching-up preceded 2015, while subsequent dependence and limited innovation capacity characterise several regional development traps. This is structural evidence about manufacturing capability, not an assessment of screening interventions.

results.reader_title: Circular economies linked to energy diversification
